item.description: Crews are working to isolate the break on a 48-inch water main on 14 Mile at Verona, between Drake and Farmington Roads.

item.title: 2 dead in Lodi Township crash
item.description: A Newport woman and a Saline man were killed at about 4 p.m. Friday when they were involved in a head-on collision on Ann Arbor-Saline Road, near Bluegrass Lane. Both of the deceased were 58-years-old. The deceased were the drivers of the two vehicles. A passenger from one of the vehicles was hospitalized with serious, but non-fatal injuries. The cause of the crash remains under investigation. The Washtenaw County Sheriff’s Office Secondary Road Patrol Traffic Services Unit is investigating.

item.title: Body found floating in Bolles Harbor
item.description: The body of a 34-year-old Sterling Heights woman was discovered floating in Bolles Harbor just before noon Saturday. Members of the Monroe Township Fire Department walked into the water and brought the body to shore, where she was quickly identified.The woman was Jeanne Renee Peterson, who was reported missing in December. She had been seen jumping off the Macarthur Bridge in Detroit the day she went missing. Peterson was taken to the Lucas County Coroner's Office in Ohio for an autopsy.

item.title: National Weather Service confirms three separate tornados hit southwestern Michigan Friday night
item.description: After sending survey crews to the region, the National Weather Service confirmed that three separate tornadoes ripped through southwestern Michigan Friday night, leaving four people dead. A lone supercell developed in La Porte County, Indiana, that moved up into Cass, St Joseph, and Branch counties in Michigan, where the death and destruction happened.
